description: This file declares an interface ICapture within the WPEFramework::Exchange namespace. The interface provides methods for capturing screen data and managing storage of captured data, along with an associated nested interface IStore for storing pixel data. It is intended as a part of the plugin or module interface for capturing images or screens.

classes.name: ICapture
classes.description: An interface for capturing screen images and retrieving an instance of the capture utility. It includes a method to get the name of the capture device or interface, a method to perform a capture using a provided IStore for storing pixel data, and a static method to obtain an instance of the interface.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the capture interface as a string.

methods.name: Capture
methods.description: Performs a screen capture, storing the result using the provided IStore object.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Provides a singleton instance of the ICapture interface.

nested_interfaces.name: IStore
nested_interfaces.description: An interface for storing pixel data from a capture. Implementations define how pixel buffers are handled; for example, how to store R8, G8, B8, A8 pixel data from the buffer.

ctags.name: ICapture
ctags.pattern: /^    struct EXTERNAL ICapture : virtual public Core::IUnknown {$/
